snippet.title: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike — Out Now on Steam (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
House of Pips is OUT NOW on Steam — 20% off for a limited time! A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Play solo or online.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5296680/House_of_Pips/?utm_source=youtube
